questions.question: If A % B means ‘A is the son of B’ A + B means ‘A is the brother of B’ A = B means ‘A is the wife of B’ A # B means ‘A is the husband of B’ If Q + M % T = R % D # K, then how is K related to Q?
questions.questionHtml:
If A % B means ‘A is the son of B’

A + B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A = B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A # B means ‘A is the husband of B’

If Q + M % T = R % D # K, then how is K related to Q?
questions.solution:
Given:

In a certain code language,

A % B means ‘A is the son of B’

A + B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A = B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A # B means ‘A is the husband of B’

Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree

                                                         A is
Symbol         %            +       =        #
Meaning     Son       Brother     Wife      Husband

                                                         of B

On checking:  Q + M % T = R % D # K

1) Q + M

'Q + M' means 'Q is brother of M'.

2) M % T

'M % T' means 'M is son of T'.

3) T = R

'T % R' means 'T is wife of R'.

4) R % D

'R % D' means 'R is son of D'.

5) D # K

'D % K' means 'D is husband of K'.

  • Thus, the following family tree can be drawn:

  • Clearly K is 'Paternal grandmother' of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Paternal grandmother".

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'A + B' means 'A is the sister of B', 'A - B' means 'A is the husband of B', 'A × B' means 'A is the mother of B’ and 'A ÷ B' means 'A is the son of B'. How is T related to W if 'T ÷ U × V + W - X'?
questions.questionHtml:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the sister of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the husband of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the mother of B’

and 'A ÷ B' means 'A is the son of B'.

How is T related to W if 'T ÷ U × V + W - X'?
questions.solution: Thus, T is brother of W

questions.question: Study the following information carefully and answer the given questions: If ‘P # Q’ means ‘P is the mother of Q’ If ‘P % Q’ means ‘P is the father of Q’ If ‘P & Q’ means ‘P is the sister of Q’ If ‘P @ Q’ means ‘P is the brother of Q’ If ‘D @ E # C % O @ R’ is given, then how is E related to O?
questions.questionHtml:
Study the following information carefully and answer the given questions:

If ‘P # Q’ means ‘P is the mother of Q’

If ‘P % Q’ means ‘P is the father of Q’

If ‘P & Q’ means ‘P is the sister of Q’

If ‘P @ Q’ means ‘P is the brother of Q’

If ‘D @ E # C % O @ R’ is given, then how is E related to O?
questions.solution:
‘D @ E # C % O @ R’ means D is brother of E, E is mother of C, C is father of O, O is brother of R.

Hence, E is grandmother of O.

questions.question: If 'P × Q' means 'P is the daughter of Q', 'P + Q' means 'P is the father of Q'; 'P ÷ Q' means 'P is the mother of Q' and 'P - Q' means 'P is the brother of Q', then in the expression A ÷ B + C - E × F, how is A related to F?
questions.questionHtml: If 'P × Q' means 'P is the daughter of Q', 'P + Q' means 'P is the father of Q'; 'P ÷ Q' means 'P is the mother of Q' and 'P - Q' means 'P is the brother of Q', then in the expression A ÷ B + C - E × F, how is A related to F?
questions.solution:
According to the question:

 A ÷ B + C - E × F → A is the mother of B who is the father of C who is the brother of E who is the daughter of F.

As B is the father of C and E, and E is the daughter of F, implies, F is the wife of B.

 

Hence, A is the "mother-in-law" of F.
